title: Head Of Event Services
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.

  2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.

3.Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.

  1. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration:

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.

  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity

  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills

Missão

O Analista de Marca e Comunicação terá como missão atuar na área de Marca e Comunicação do CIEDS, com atendimento prioritário a demandas de projetos. Entre os principais desafios, a pessoa profissional será responsável por: 

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de comunicação alinhadas aos objetivos institucionais e às tendências de mercado;
  • Garantir a interlocução com parceiros, tanto em nível nacional quanto internacional;
  • Produção para a comunicação digital, que engloba a gestão de redes sociais (com conteúdo orgânico e pago), conteúdo para site e para e-mail marketing.

Buscamos um perfil analítico, propositivo, curioso, atento às tendências de mercado e com habilidade para executar, organizar e colaborar. É essencial saber trabalhar em equipe e demonstrar capacidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico.

Atribuições Essenciais

  • Atendimento a clientes internos: fazer a interface entre as demandas de projetos e o time de Marca e Comunicação, desenvolvendo e encaminhando briefings para atendimento, especialmente para demandas de design;
  • Planejamento de conteúdo: desenvolver e acompanhar estratégias de conteúdo para canais digitais (Site, Instagram, LinkedIn, Blog e E-mail Marketing);
  • Produção de conteúdo: apurar e criar de conteúdos, incluindo copys para redes sociais (orgânicos e anúncios), site, newsletter, apresentações, e-mail marketing e materiais impressos (banners, flyers, etc.);
  • Gerenciamento de tráfego pago: planejar e executar impulsionamentos de posts orgânicos e campanhas de dark posts;
  • Gestão de comunidade: realizar a gestão de comentários e mensagens diretas de Instagram e LinkedIn;
  • Monitoramento: monitorar o desempenho de publicações e anúncios em redes sociais, propondo ajustes e melhorias com base nos resultados. Elaborar relatórios com principais métricas e insights;
  • Eventos: oferecer suporte em eventos, incluindo contato e gestão de fornecedores de peças de comunicação, captação e edição de imagens e vídeos, e acompanhamento de entregas;
  • Contato com fornecedores: ser ponto focal da interlocução de fornecedores de comunicação, como fotógrafos, videomakers e influencers;

Conhecimentos específicos

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Habilidade para lidar com públicos diversos de maneira eficaz;
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel;
  • Experiência em criação de conteúdo e monitoramento de desempenho em redes sociais (orgânico e anúncios);
  • Redação otimizada para sites, com foco em SEO;
  • Inglês intermediário, com capacidade de interação por escrito em ferramentas e com profissionais; 
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de e-mail marketing, como MailChimp, HubSpot, GetResponse, entre outras;
  • Experiência em captação e edição básica de vídeo, com ferramentas como o CapCut;
  • Familiaridade com Plataformas Google (Analytics, Trends, Google Ads).

Diferencial

  • Experiência prévia no terceiro setor, seja como beneficiário ou voluntário;
  • Pós-graduação;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas do pacote Adobe;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Frontend
description:
About The Role
Please note: this hybrid position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.
At Uber, Frontend Engineers build web experiences that power the way people move and receive things around the world. As part of our engineering team, you'll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product). Your work will help shape the future of Uber's Delivery, defining how people interact with Uber on the web.

About The Team
The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues.
  • Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems.
  • Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area.
  • Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross-functional project dynamics.

What You'll Need

  • 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications.
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.
  • Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS.
  • Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability.
  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.
  • Familiarity with back-end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full-stack issues.
  • Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production.

title: Tecnico Seguranca Do Trabalho

TECNICO SEGURANCA DO TRABALHO

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

The domain of safety is managed and developed on the site:

  • The external and internal requirements of the domain are identified (regulatory watch and prescriptions). Based on gap analyses, action plans are proposed. The guarantee of the site's compliance with internal regulations and requirements is controlled.
  • The site has relevant and exhaustive risk analyses and action plans are defined.
  • In the context of design projects, the purchase of new machines, technical transformations of equipment or organizational changes in jobs, the position of the site safety specialist is defined and transmitted to the project team in the form of an "Avis EP".
  • The current operating anomalies in the domain are analysed and taken into account. The necessary alerts are transmitted.
  • Good practices are shared within the site and across the country. The site safety specialist participates in or leads the business meetings of his network.
  • The annual review of the domain is presented by the site safety specialist during the EP Management Sytem Review of the site.
  • The safety specialist is the leader in his domain in terms of team support, management system and site events: steering committees, bib events, training.
  • External and internal partners are identified, and the safety specialist is the site's referent in these networks.
  • Technical support in the domain will be provided in the event of an audit (EP Management system or other audit/inspection) and in the event of a crisis impacting the area.
  • If necessary, specific projects in the field will be conducted in the form of transversal management (T-shape for example).
  • Where possible, participation in audits of other sites or even the conduct of audits will be entrusted to the site's safety specialist.
  • Where possible, the coordination of the domain at the country level will be carried out by the site safety specialist, under the guidance of the time zone.

title: Psicólogo - supervisor aba (2)
description:
MISSÃO:

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES:

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.

ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO:

- Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.

- Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.

- Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).

- Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL:

- Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects
  • Ability to work, deliver, and steer under pressure
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize project management tools to plan and manage projects
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently on both local and global projects
  • Motivated in personal growth and development
  • Ability to problem solve, think critically, and have strong analytical, organizational, project management, and decision-making skill set
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and with clients
  • People Management and leadership skills

What We Offer

  • A team of bright, hard-working, and innovative people that will contribute to your growth
  • Competitive compensation package

Other

This is a remote work opportunity.

Closing

At Mobiz, we value diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone feels welcome and respected. Mobiz is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and encourages individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities to apply.

title: Analista De Dados
description:
Quem somos?


A é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas a vendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos?


O Analista de Dados é responsável por projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar sistemas e arquiteturas de dados, garantindo a coleta, armazenamento, processamento e análise eficiente de grandes volumes de informações para apoiar decisões estratégicas.

Responsabilidades:


  • Coleta de Dados: Identificar e coletar dados relevantes de várias fontes, como bancos de dados, logs, streams de dados, APIs, entre outros.

  • Armazenamento de Dados: Projetar e implementar sistemas de armazenamento de dados eficientes e escaláveis, que podem incluir bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL, data warehouses, e sistemas de armazenamento distribuídos.

  • Processamento de Dados: Desenvolver pipelines de processamento de dados para limpar, transformar e preparar dados para análise. Isso pode envolver o uso de ferramentas como, Apache Spark, ou outras soluções de processamento distribuído.

  • Integração de Dados: Garantir a integridade e a consistência dos dados ao integrar informações de diferentes fontes.

  • Segurança e Privacidade: Implementar medidas de segurança e garantir a conformidade com regulamentações de privacidade de dados.

  • Análise de Dados: Facilitar o acesso aos dados para análise, seja por meio de ferramentas de visualização, consulta direta ou outras formas de análise de dados.

  • Monitoramento e Otimização: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados, identificar gargalos e otimizar o desempenho conforme necessário.

  • Colaboração com Equipes: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com cientistas de dados, analistas de negócios e outros profissionais para entender e atender às necessidades de dados da organização.

  • Documentação: Manter documentação clara e abrangente sobre arquiteturas de dados, fluxos de trabalho, processos de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga), e outros aspectos relacionados aos sistemas de dados.

  • Resolução de Problemas: Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados a dados, como inconsistências, falhas no processamento ou questões de desempenho.

  • Treinamento e Colaboração: Colaborar com outros membros da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento e oferecendo treinamento quando necessário, especialmente para garantir que os dados sejam utilizados de forma eficaz por toda a organização.

  • Governança de Dados: Implementar práticas de governança de dados para garantir a qualidade, consistência e conformidade dos dados, além de estabelecer políticas para o uso adequado e ético das informações.

  • Gerenciamento de Projeto: Participar de projetos de dados desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo que os prazos sejam cumpridos e que os objetivos do projeto sejam alcançados.

  • Colaboração com DevOps: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para integrar práticas de DevOps no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de sistemas de dados.

    • Requisitos:


  • Linguagens: Python, SQL avançado.

  • Bancos de Dados: Relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL), Colunar (Clickhouse, BigQuery).

  • ETL e Modelagem: Airflow, dbt Cloud/dbt CLI.

  • Big Data & Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Apache Flink (desejável).

  • Cloud e Infraestrutura: Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm.

  • Controle de Versão: Git.

  • Governança de Dados: Qualidade, metadados e linhagem de dados.

  • Habilidades Analíticas: Solução de problemas e otimização de processos.

  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário (desejável).

  • Salário competitivo.

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Description
Job Overview:
The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive-level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi-phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi-dimensional models that support real-time decision-making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long-term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge-sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data-driven decision-making

Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project-driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

About Us
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Performance
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Planejamento e Performance Comercial com visão estratégica e forte capacidade analítica, para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence (BI) e otimização dos processos comerciais da empresa. Este papel é essencial para garantir o acompanhamento de vendas, metas e indicadores de performance, além de apoiar a análise de dados para tomada de decisões mais assertivas.

Além de contribuir com o monitoramento contínuo de resultados e performance comercial, você será responsável pela implementação e atualização dos relatórios de BI, análise de dados comerciais e pela identificação de lacunas e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de vendas. Seu trabalho ajudará a estruturar ações estratégicas baseadas em dados, promovendo a evolução contínua da performance comercial e corporativa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar relatórios e dashboards utilizando Business Intelligence (BI) para análise detalhada de dados comerciais, proporcionando insights estratégicos para as equipes de vendas e liderança.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das vendas e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas, identificando padrões e comportamentos de vendas para otimização de resultados.
  • Monitorar e atualizar constantemente o painel de metas e indicadores de performance de todos os departamentos, tanto corporativo quanto comercial, garantindo a precisão dos dados e a transparência na comunicação dos resultados.
  • Realizar a homologação de dados junto à supervisão comercial, com base nas análises de dados comerciais, para determinar as necessidades de recursos humanos (colaboradores) necessários para o atendimento da demanda.
  • Estudar e identificar lacunas operacionais e comerciais, propondo e implementando ações corretivas e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de Marketing, Comercial e Recursos Humanos, para garantir que as metas sejam alcançadas e que as estratégias estejam alinhadas com as necessidades do mercado.
  • Criar análises de tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor, com base nos dados coletados, para apoiar decisões comerciais mais assertivas e identificar oportunidades de vendas.
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade de novas oportunidades de negócios, com base nas análises de dados, propondo ajustes nas estratégias comerciais.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de planejamento estratégico a partir das análises de performance e indicadores de vendas.
  • Garantir que as estratégias de vendas sejam baseadas em dados, colaborando com os times para maximizar os resultados.
  • Contribuir para a definição e acompanhamento de projeções comerciais, oferecendo insights sobre previsões de vendas e alocação de recursos.
  • Realizar apresentações periódicas de resultados e sugestões de melhorias para as equipes de liderança e stakeholders.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia de Produção, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise de dados comerciais e indicadores de performance, com expertise em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, entre outras).
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel, com habilidades em análise de grandes volumes de dados e automação de relatórios.
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de metas e performance, com visão analítica e estratégica voltada para resultados.
  • Habilidade em interpretação de dados para elaboração de estratégias e tomada de decisão.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades para apresentar informações complexas de forma clara e objetiva.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com acompanhamento de equipes comerciais e definição de recursos necessários para a demanda.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de metas, KPIs e monitoramento de performance comercial.
  • Vivência com planejamento estratégico, análise de viabilidade de novos negócios e definição de orçamentos.

Nossa Cultura:


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Rotina híbrida com reuniões presenciais e online;

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito e do setor financeiro;     
  • Experiência em riscos de crédito na concessão de crédito e matemática financeira;     
  • Habilidade em negociação e gestão de carteira;

title: Customer Service
description:
Company Description

Social Media | Customer Service | Community Manager | Global team | Remote | Brazil

BE PART OF OUR GLOBAL TEAM AND MAKE AN IMPACT HERE AT BRICKBRANDS     

BrickBrands is in the business of providing 24/7 brand protection, positive brand sentiment and overall increased customer engagement in various languages and cultures.

BrickBrands is a fast-growing company offering a lot of opportunities and valuable learning experiences that open doors for talented individuals to be a part of our global team. We embrace and promote diversity and inclusivity, the first step in building better relationships and conversations. Thus BrickBrands is always on the lookout for self-starters with the passion to excel and to join us in our mission: Create opportunities for brands and communities to speak.

Job Description

Summary of the Role

As a Social-First Customer Care Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for users across social channels (public comments and DMs) and email. You'll support customers of a leading digital subscription-based product suite and help maintain a positive brand presence by responding to customer questions, resolving issues, and escalating when needed.

This role is ideal for someone who's quick, calm under pressure, great with people, and comfortable supporting users with account access, subscriptions, billing, and product-related troubleshooting in a highly visible environment.

What You'll Do
You'll be the frontline voice of the brand across social, helping customers in real time while keeping responses human, clear, and platform-native.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Responding to public comments with strong judgment, context awareness, and the right brand tone
  • Managing direct messages (DMs) and private support conversations end-to-end
  • Using a CRM to review customer history, track cases, and document outcomes clearly
  • Supporting common customer service needs including:
    • Account and login support
    • Subscription, billing, refunds, and cancellations
    • Retention-style conversations (when appropriate)
    • Access, download, install, or "it's not working" troubleshooting
  • Providing basic product guidance and technical triage, escalating when needed
  • Using AI-assisted drafting tools to respond faster while ensuring every message is accurate, empathetic, and safe before sending
  • Following established escalation paths for high-risk issues, sensitive topics, and VIP situations
  • Contributing to consistent quality across shifts (tone, accuracy, decision-making)

Qualifications

Here's What You Will Need:

  • A High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in social care, community management, CX support, or digital customer service
  • Strong verbal communication & writing skills (friendly, clear, and socially native)
  • Comfort handling customer issues like billing, subscriptions, access problems, and troubleshooting
  • Calm under pressure and confident in high-visibility comment sections
  • Organized, accountable, and consistent 
  • Fluent in English both written and oral
  • General knowledge and interest in various social media platforms  
  • A good working home environment with a stable internet connection
  • The ability to work an 8-hour shift on a rotating shift schedule

Nice to have:

  • Near native Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish or French
  • Familiarity with creative or technical digital products (design, photo/video editing, productivity tools, generative AI tools)
  • Experience working within a CRM, or social tools such as Sprout, Sprinklr etc. 
  • Experience supporting subscription-based or SaaS products
  • Experience with moderation and customer engagement in high-volume social environments

Additional Information

The Perks BrickBrands Offers:

  • 100% Remote position
  • Continuous learning experience & career growth opportunities
  • Offers competitive compensation based on location market rates
  • A great opportunity to work with some of the world's coolest and most innovative brands
  • A welcoming environment where even your feedback and suggestions are all being taken into consideration
  • Enjoy working in a diverse & global team environment - BrickBrands team members come from different backgrounds

Interested to work in social media that is focused on customer care, while working remotely from home with a global team? Send your CV in ENGLISH.

This role requires a highly organized and motivated individual with excellent relationship management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Create a systematic, process-driven approach for partner outreach and relationship management.
  • Develop an on-boarding plan and certification program to the partners to be completed following the enablement and orientation sessions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement joint marketing, sales, and support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with senior management, Business Development teams, and Strategy Manager to align our internal goals with new and existing partner relationships in LATAM.
  • Represent ProgressSoft at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote brand awareness and build strategic relationships.
  • Negotiate partnership agreements and contracts, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and aligned with ProgressSoft´s objectives.
  • Develop a "Partner Kit" and collaborate with the marketing team to ensure partners receive the appropriate materials including branding guidelines, product summaries and presentations as applicable.
  • Work in liaison with the Business Development member handling the assigned territory to align on partnership agreement scopes, quotas, products covered, exclusivity, etc...
  • Maintain an ongoing relationship with current partners and offer new ways to grow the partnership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at partner organizations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including Business Development, Marketing, strategy, Product Development, and Operations, to support partnership initiatives and drive results.
  • Identify and source partnership opportunities through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls, emails, and client visits in LATAM.
  • Proactively seek out new partnership opportunities that align with the company's strategic goals, Business Development team's needs, and potentially complimentary products.
  • Analyze potential partnerships to assess strategic fit, value proposition, and potential ROI.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitor activities, and identify emerging technologies and partners.
  • Forecast, measure, and report the results of various projects with partners, including co-created and/or co-branded content promotions, lead sharing, and/or event partnerships.
  • Analyze partnership performance, challenges, and opportunities to provide regular reports and insights to internal stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Possesses 3-5 years of experience in partnership management. 
  • Experienced in the IT and banking industry best practices, with a strong understanding of emerging technologies and their impact on financial services. 
  • Excellent knowledge of local LATAM payments infrastructure & industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing partnerships.
  • Ability to track and analyze partnership performance. 
  • Ability to evolve in a complex environment.
  • Ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent negotiation and strategic thinking skills. 
  • Proficiency in written and verbal communication in English is a must.

title: Analista de Atendimento Ativo
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 

O time de Logística:


A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes. 

Conheça um pouco mais do time de Logística no Nosso Manifesto.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Logística - Atendimento Ativo (Recuperação de Terminais) | HUNTER ANGEL:


Conhecido como Hunter Angels, esse time tem a missão de reduzir a quantidade de perdas de máquinas e aumentar a eficiência da cadeia logística, gerando rentabilidade para a companhia.

Para isso, a sua rotina é realizar atendimento ativo aos clientes por meio de telefone e, quando necessário, em múltiplos canais para recuperação dos terminais (maquininhas) que estão em clientes inativos.

 As principais atividades são:

  • Atuar no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Abrir ordens de serviço para que o time de Green Angels realize a coleta de maquininhas;
  • Realizar o cancelamento do cadastro dos clientes.

O que esperamos de você: 

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído (preferencialmente em administração, engenharias, logística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ativo ao cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Foco no cumprimento de metas;
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças;
  • Energia e protagonismo;
  • Disponibilidade de horário entre as 09h às 20h

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.
  • Habilidade analítica. 
  • Já ter atuado com atingimento de metas.

Jornada de Trabalho: 

  • CLT: 40 horas semanais com 1h de intervalo diário | Escala: 5x2 (Segunda-feira a Sexta-feira)

Nossos Benefícios:


Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo

Salário Fixo + PLR (quando preenchidos os requisitos)

Remuneração variável 

30% de adicional por periculosidade em cima do salário fixo, apenas em caso de uso de motocicleta (exclusivo para vagas externas) 

  Benefício Educação  - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e video aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo).

Obs: Vaga de Estágio não contempla remuneração variável, auxilio creche, convênio SESC, PLR e adicional de periculosidade.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto. 

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Case Técnico (Em vagas de liderança) : Você apresentará a resolução de um case técnico simulando problemas que enfrentamos hoje na operação, tanto no assunto de pessoas quanto no de resultados.
Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone  


Aqui na Stone Co. valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente Caso queira saber mais:

  • Vem conhecer como começamos e o nosso propósito no YouTube.  
  • Temos vários artigos, cursos e vídeos para o seu desenvolvimento no nosso Blog. 
  • E pra ficar por dentro de todas as novidades, é só nos seguir no Twitter e Instagram. 
  • Confira aqui as diretrizes do nosso Código de Ética.

title: Core & ML Ops Team Lead - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
Zyte is seeking an experienced Team Lead to manage our Core & MLOps Squad, responsible for "Building the bedrock infrastructure that powers Zyte at scale." This hands-on technical leadership role requires expertise across MLOps, systems programming, and orchestration to lead a cross-functional team in designing and maintaining the scalable foundation that enables all Zyte teams to build and run their services with confidence.

Requirements

What you'll do

Technical Leadership

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute).
  • Own the model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation, serving, and monitoring.

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses.

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap/prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards.

Ownership Areas

  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Knative), GPU provisioning & autoscaling, environment & secret management.
  • Operators, sidecars, and internal SDKs/libraries (Go/Rust/Python/Java) that enforce the golden path contract.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years experience building distributed systems; 3+ years in MLOps/ML platform engineering (or equivalent impact).

  • Proficiency developing high-performance services in Java, Rust, Go or C++ (bonus: familiarity with vert.x and Netty frameworks); strong Python skills.

  • Track record of designing and operating model platforms (registry, training, serving, monitoring) in production.

Preferred

  • eBPF‑based observability, perf tooling, or io_uring experience
  • Cost optimization for ML/AI; multi‑tenant quotas and fairness.

Quem somos


A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia, especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis. Parte do ABL Group, atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, sempre com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade.

Com uma atuação integrada globalmente, a Longitude conta também com um time no Brasil, que trabalha de forma colaborativa com equipes internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores


? Missão
Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

? Visão
Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

? Valores

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar

  • Technical excellence – qualidade e precisão técnica

  • Collaboration – trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança

  • Innovation – melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes

  • Integrity & transparency – ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga


Você atuará como Engineering Job Leader da disciplina de Processo, sendo o responsável técnico direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e garantia da qualidade das entregas de engenharia de processo em projetos de plataformas de produção offshore, tanto flutuantes quanto fixas.

Além da atuação nos projetos locais, o profissional interagirá ativamente com projetos da Longitude ao redor do mundo, trabalhando de forma integrada com equipes multidisciplinares e multiculturais. Essa atuação inclui o compartilhamento de experiências, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas, bem como o suporte técnico a projetos internacionais, contribuindo para a consistência técnica e a excelência de engenharia em toda a organização.

Principais atividades


? Liderar tecnicamente a disciplina de Processo em projetos offshore, garantindo aderência aos requisitos técnicos, normas e escopo contratado.

? Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos de engenharia de processo, incluindo Design Basis , PFDs, P&IDs, balanços de massa e energia.

Revisar, validar e aprovar tecnicamente os entregáveis de processo elaborados por equipes internas ou por empresas subcontratadas, atuando como autoridade técnica da disciplina.

? Conduzir e supervisionar simulações e cálculos de processo relacionados à produção, separação, tratamento, sistemas de utilidades e flare.

? Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com outras disciplinas de engenharia, assegurando integração e consistência entre os projetos.

? Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente e às equipes globais da Longitude, participando de reuniões técnicas e tomadas de decisão.

? Contribuir para a padronização, melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico em nível global, fortalecendo as melhores práticas da organização.

Requisitos


? Formação
Graduação completa em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

? Experiência Profissional
Experiência sólida em engenharia de processos aplicada a projetos offshore.

? Conhecimento Técnico
Domínio no desenvolvimento e revisão de Design Basis, PFDs, P&IDs, balanços de massa e energia.

? Ferramentas
Experiência com softwares de simulação de processo (ex.: Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus ou similares).

?‍?‍? Liderança e Interface
Capacidade de atuar como autoridade técnica, gerenciando interfaces multidisciplinares e interação com clientes e subcontratados.

Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times das plataformas de engenharia de dados são responsáveis por disponibilizar todo o ferramental de tratamento das informações capturadas, permitindo a sua transformação em dados estruturados. Além do uso interno, essas ferramentas também estão integradas nos Plugins para uso dos clientes. Essas plataformas incluem os serviços de parsing e estruturação de dados, serviços de validação de dados, serviços de associação de entidades, armazenamento e gestão de passagens, e criação e gestão de metadados, dentre outros.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou algum curso relacionado;
  • Experiência prévia na área de desenvolvimento;
  • Ter experiência profissional com alguma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos;
  • Ter contribuído com o desenvolvimento de pelo menos 3 (três) projetos na área;
  • Familiaridade com lógica de programação, conhecer e entender conceitos básicos como sintaxe, tipos de dados, variáveis, operadores básicos, condicionais, loops, e funções, e conhecer e entender estruturas de dados básicas, tais como vetores e listas;
  • Conhecer e entender sobre complexidade de algoritmos, conhecer e entender conceitos relacionados a Orientação a Objetos, tais como classes, objetos, encapsulamento, polimorfismo, herança, e abstração, e conhecer e entender estruturas de dados mais avançadas, tais como pilhas, filas, árvores, e tabelas hash;
  • Familiaridade com comandos, atalhos e funcionalidades mais usados da IDE no dia-a-dia, ter familiaridade com versionamento de código, conhecer os serviços de nuvem mais utilizados, saber utilizar a ferramenta de atualização de status de tarefas, e saber utilizar a ferramenta de comunicação interna da empresa;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns).

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos:

  • Experiência com C# ou Python;
  • Experiência em uso de ferramenta de versionamento de código (GIT);
  • Experiência com computação em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Experiência em documentação e manutenção de processos.

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo.  Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias. 

Criamos o Banco de Talentos para acelerar o processo de recrutamento e seleção, trazendo maior transparência para os candidatos, e mais agilidade para o time interno trabalhando com este processo. Se você curtiu e se identificou com a nossa empresa, inscreva-se em nosso Banco de Talentos Seja a primeira pessoa a ser considerada para oportunidades na BDC.

Sobre a área e a vaga

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer. 

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de integração contínua/entrega contínua (CI/CD) no Gitlab;
  • Realizar monitoramento, escalabilidade e automação de processos de implantação;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das práticas de DevOps;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a entrega de software;
  • Manter ferramentas de análise de código e de segurança integradas com a pipeline, como Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Manter documentação técnica detalhada e compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe;
  • Participar na configuração e gerenciamento de recursos em ambientes AWS;
  • Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada como DevOps em um ambiente de TI, com ênfase em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Proficiência em Terraform para laC;
  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;
  • Conhecimento sólido em monitoramento e soluções de automação;
  • Familiaridade com integração das pipelines com ferramentas de análise de código e segurança, como, por exemplo, Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

Será um diferencial

  • Conhecimento em ZapProxy, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center;
  • Certificações relevantes da AWS.

Benefits

title: Freelance Software Developer
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Coding, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects. 

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design and maintain automated tests to ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of Kotlin and Android applications.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, reproduce, and resolve functional, performance, and UI issues across multiple environments.
  • Define and improve quality standards across build pipelines, ensuring smooth CI/CD integrations and release stability.
  • Monitor app behavior in production and use data‑driven insights to guide testing priorities and improvements.

Note: Flexibility and quick adaptation to new requirements are essential.

How to get started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Software Development, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or other related fields.
  • Mid-level proficiency in Swift 5.9+, including SwiftUI, Combine, async/await, and the concurrency model.
  • 3+ years of professional iOS/macOS development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with testing frameworks (XCTest, Quick/Nimble) and UI automation testing.
  • Proficiency with Xcode, Swift Package Manager, and CI/CD tools (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Xcode Cloud).
  • Experience with App Store deployment and monitoring tools (Crashlytics, Firebase).
  • Strong understanding of architectural patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture) and performance optimization (ARC, Instruments).
  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities (Core ML, Vision, Create ML).
  • Practical use of AI-assisted tools for code generation, refactoring, and test automation.
  • Strong skills in crash analysis, memory debugging, and performance profiling.
  • Level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Job Summary:
Join our global team as an online teacher for IGCSE/IAL (Pearson Edexcel) and immerse yourself in a premium one-on-one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pearson Edexcel and A-Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.

  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.

  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.

  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.

  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA's rich resource library.

  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.

  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.

  • Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A-Levels curricula and examinations.

Preferred Qualifications:

About Crimson Global Academy:

CGA is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

If you're passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one-on-one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now

title: FF&E Procurement
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

Orchestrate relationships with top-tier suppliers / manufacturers and spearhead cost-effective procurement strategies tailored to the unique demands of our UTOPIA LIVING operations.

In general will be responsible for ordering, administration and supply procurement of the FF&E, OS&E, design and supply within the team.  It will be your responsibility to ensure that the orders are made on time, within budget and in the most efficient manner, ensuring that the Finance Department is kept informed of all necessary compliance.

At a glance:

  • FF&E/Fit Out Budgets and Cost Planning
  • Tendering and Market Research
  • Contracts and Purchase Orders management
  • Payment Forecast and Cost control
  • Logistic, Delivery and Installation plus Handover

You will:

  • Collaborate with Sr. FF&E Procurement Manager, Architects and Senior FF&E/Interior Designer to ascertain the timeline, budget and deadlines of the project
  • Assist the FF&E/Interior Designer with sourcing all the information necessary to complete the detailed specification document
  • Work with the design team to build the initial procurement schedule based on the review of layouts, renderings & specifications of the project
  • Responsible for the compilation of the procurement budget and coordinating all documentation ensuring all document standards are met
  • Organize the purchasing schedule, liaising with the Sr. Procurement and Project managers to ensure all project milestones are reached
  • Working closely with the Finance team to raise Funding Requests, produce purchase orders and pay proforma invoices in timely manner
  • Receive, approve and pass invoices for payment and log on procurement schedule
  • Liaise with suppliers across the globe to obtain quotes and discuss terms of service
  • To work within set budgets and timeframes, ensuring items meet the required specification and can be delivered on time
  • Liaise with internal teams and contractors to organize FF&E logistics and installation
  • Quality control
  • Ensure all supplier contacts are up to date
  • Carry out existing supplier reviews & new supplier visits in order to provide a list of approved suppliers to consideration on projects
  • Maintain accurate procurement & budget records & collate information for a weekly procurement review

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Supply Chain or Logistic, preferably Master's degree in any of above
  • Project Management degree (Master's or equivalent) is a plus
  • Must have a minimum of 3 years experience within a procurement agency or design studio in a similar role.
  • Advanced/fluent in English and Portquese - required
  • Experience dealing with global projects and suppliers - markets across Europe, Brazil, DR, and Latin America advantageous.
  • Experience in establishing and executing new processes
  • Experience in preparing O&M Manuals for Hospitality projects

Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: REMOTE - Corporate Compliance Team Lead
description:
About World Business Lenders )

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL services its loan portfolio and loan portfolios for third parties, specializing in the management of non-performing loan pools and REO.

WBL is a U.S.-based company with a 100% remote workforce.

This is a remote Contract/Consultant position.

Working hours will be 9:00am-6:00pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

The job requires excellent oral and written command of the English language. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Location:

  • 100% Remote for Turkey, LATAM and India

Requirements

Job Duties and Responsibilities

We are seeking a Corporate Legal Compliance Team Lead to oversee regulatory compliance related to corporate operations, contract governance, and licensing requirements across U.S. federal and state frameworks. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience ensuring adherence to laws impacting corporate transactions, lending activities, and regulatory reporting obligations

  • Assist in the execution of the compliance program, including monitoring the effectiveness of controls, managing regulatory reporting obligations, and ensuring adherence to corporate policies and procedures.
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with U.S. federal and state regulatory requirements related to contract law, licensing, consumer protection, and business operations, including residential and commercial lending.
  • Support cross-functional teams in interpreting and implementing new regulatory obligations impacting lending, contract governance, and corporate compliance frameworks.
  • Monitor regulatory environments to identify emerging compliance risks and requirements; develop strategic responses and guide cross-functional teams in implementing risk-based solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Support the Compliance Officer during regulatory examinations and internal audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses to regulatory inquiries.
  • Foster a culture of compliance by collaborating with business teams and supporting the delivery of training programs.
  • Oversee the development of reports and analytics for senior management, and assess the need for new licenses.
  • Contribute to the design and development of controls by translating AML/CTF regulatory requirements and other applicable U.S. regulatory obligations into actionable measures.
  • Supervise the ongoing development of compliance testing programs.
  • Serve as a key advisor and deputy to the Compliance Officer, supporting strategic initiatives, special projects, and critical compliance matters.
  • Travel to the U.S. as needed for on-site requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Law degree from a nationally accredited U.S. law school.
  • 6–10 years of experience practicing law within a law firm; in-house experience is a plus.
  • 5–10 years of regulatory and compliance experience within the residential mortgage banking industry across the United States.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state laws, regulations, and licensing requirements related to residential and commercial mortgage lending as well as corporate governance.
  • Proven ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents, supported by advanced legal research and writing skills.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, demonstrating sound business judgment and effective problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional command of English, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with keen attention to detail and strong follow-through.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while managing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Highly proactive and resourceful, with the ability to build effective working relationships across teams and departments.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and Adobe applications.
  • Valid U.S. visa required.

Benefits

  • CONTRACT/CONSULTANCY POSITION

title: Country Sales Director
description:
Company Background

Our client is a subsidiary of a large industrial group specializing in industrial supply chain technology and services, with an estimated market value of approximately USD 5 billion.

They support the industrial sector through an integrated supply chain + technology + services model and operate a B2B procurement platform for industrial products. The company serves more than 7,000 key account clients and over 8 million SMEs, supported by approximately 30,000 suppliers and a catalog of more than 40 million SKUs.

The company is actively expanding its international and overseas business, providing one-stop MRO procurement solutions across Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and South America.

Role Overview

The Country Sales Director is responsible for key account management, B2B sales strategy, MRO solution development, revenue growth, team leadership, and market analysis.

The role reports to the Country General Manager and directly manages 5–6 Key Account Sales Managers.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Key Account Management

  • Manage and develop long-term relationships with key account (KA) customers.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer business models, procurement needs, and growth strategies.
  • Conduct regular customer communication and site visits to identify changing needs and provide professional recommendations.

MRO Solution Development

  • Design and deliver customized MRO product and service solutions aligned with customer operational and procurement requirements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to deliver end-to-end procurement solutions, including demand analysis, product selection, and after-sales support.

Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute B2B sales strategies and key account growth plans to achieve revenue and performance targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities through market research, customer insights, and industry analysis.
  • Drive market expansion and increase market share within the MRO and industrial supplies sector.

Team Leadership & Sales Management

  • Lead, train, and coach the key account sales team to improve performance and professional capabilities.
  • Establish efficient sales operations and customer service processes to improve team productivity and customer satisfaction.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments.
  • Adjust customer strategies to strengthen the company's competitive positioning.
  • Contribute to the development and optimization of key account policies and commercial strategies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; industrial engineering or related fields preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, key account management, industrial sales, or MRO-related roles.
  • Proven experience managing large enterprise clients or strategic accounts.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, international business environment.
  • Proficiency in standard office software.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English; proficiency in Malay is a plus.

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage
